_about: Diethyl carbonate (1) + Water (2): isothermal total pressures at 353.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of diethyl carbonate, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: I. C. Arango, A. L. Villa, Isothermal vapor   liquid and vapor liquid liquid equilibrium for the ternary  system ethanol + water + diethyl carbonate and constituent binary systems at  different temperatures, Fluid Phase Equilib. 339 (2013) 31-39
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).

two_liquids.source: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10, 11 (phases Liquid mixture 1 and 2)
two_liquids.notes: The two liquids in equilibrium, as stored in the record (mole fraction of component 1 in each). P is the three-phase pressure where the record gives one. Fitted as liquid-liquid equilibrium (fit_parameters.py); rows of the curve strictly between the two liquids at the same temperature are not fitted as one liquid.
